summary: Use the doc-tools v0.1.0 release for documentation checks. scripts/doc-tools.sh pins the release version and archive SHA-256, verifies the archive before extraction, and installs it in the ignored .tools directory. The script runs the package ste-lint.sh wrapper on explicit Markdown paths. New Makefile targets install the package, check explicit paths, and check Markdown that changed since a base commit. A new CI Docs job runs the changed-Markdown check and proves that a bad prose sample fails and its corrected form passes. PR Gate requires the Docs job. The contributor guide, CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md describe the setup, the checks, and the shared documentation skill. No Go package, dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: The STE check reads local Markdown files and writes findings to the terminal or the existing CI log. It sends no file content to a network destination and does not execute scanned source. Tool provisioning downloads two pinned archives from GitHub releases: the doc-tools archive and the ste-cli archive. Each archive must match a pinned SHA-256 before extraction, and a mismatch stops the check. This is the same provisioning class as the existing pinned mise, pre-commit, and go run tool downloads. The CI job uses pinned actions, contents read, no secrets, and checkout without persisted credentials.
